purpose: Retrain the existing WATTZAN municipality forecasting architecture without changing application functions.

training_use.customer_anchor: Grand Total Consumers / 12 used as an annual-average monthly consumer-entry anchor
training_use.daily_method: Existing daily intra-year shape retained and scaled so each annual total equals the original SUKELCO History Ledger exactly.
training_use.other_municipalities: Unchanged research-grade synthetic municipality daily records.
training_use.peak_capacity_weather: No original daily values were supplied; existing research fields retained. Tacurong peak_demand_kw scaled with annual consumption to preserve existing load factor.

reference_only_not_daily_training.reason: The supplied ledgers are annual route aggregates and do not contain daily timestamped load/weather observations required by the current one-day/seven-day model functions.
